Class TelemetryEvent

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.telemetry.model.TelemetryEvent
public class TelemetryEvent extends Object
Represents one recorded telemetry event, including its category, timestamp, display details, and optional source-location or execution information.

    • execution

      public static TelemetryEvent execution(EventType type, LocalDateTime timestamp, String description, String className, String methodName, String executionOutcome)
      Creates an execution-related telemetry event with method and outcome details.
      Parameters:
      type - the event category
      timestamp - the local event timestamp
      description - the event description
      className - the associated class name, or null
      methodName - the invoked method name, or null
      executionOutcome - the textual execution outcome
      Returns:
      a new execution telemetry event
